title: Creators Wilds GUI
description: A simple dark GUI made for the Creators Wilds modpack.
body:
📁 I created this GUI for my Creators Wilds modpack, which is a simple and clean interface. The design was inspired by Discord's theme, and I used the vanilla GUI as a base.

🟠 Curseforge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/creators-wilds-gui

📦 Creators Wilds modpack: https://modrinth.com/modpack/creatorswilds

> 📌Supported mods:
> - [Chalk](https://modrinth.com/mod/chalk-mod)
> - [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)
> - [Just Enough Items (JEI)](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)
> - [Polymorph](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymorph)
> - [Small Ships](https://modrinth.com/mod/small-ships)
